note: What a server sends to open the tutorial's popup: a caption, this text and a single button, which a client answers with TutorialPopupClosed. A client has one such popup; a second message replaces its text. The header carries zero.

fields.name: text
fields.note: A key into the client's own text for the popup's body. The text ends at its first zero byte, which falls within the field.
